title: Dreamer’s war with Brian Lee goes above the ring
summary: Raven’s enforcer Brian Lee repeatedly attacks Tommy Dreamer with overwhelming power. Their increasingly dangerous brawls culminate in a scaffold match above stacks of tables.

chapters.title: Lee defeats Dreamer
chapters.context: Raven’s ally becomes a continuing obstacle to Dreamer’s pursuit of his main rival.

chapters.title: Dreamer wins the scaffold match
chapters.result: Dreamer defeats Lee in the scaffold match.
chapters.context: The table-filled spectacle provides a decisive finish to their extended physical rivalry.
